headline: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino Votes To Indict Marcel Van Hattem
seoTitle: Flávio Dino Votes To Indict Marcel Van Hattem
metaDescription: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino voted to make Deputy Marcel Van Hattem a defendant for slander and injury, but the judgment was suspended by Zanin.
aiSummaryBullets: Justice Flávio Dino voted to indict Deputy Marcel Van Hattem on charges of slander and injury against a Federal Police delegate.
The legal case was initiated following public comments made by the deputy regarding the delegate's work on inquiries involving Jair Bolsonaro.
Justice Cristiano Zanin suspended the virtual judgment by requesting a highlight, moving the case to a future in-person session of the First Panel.
aiContextParagraph: The case centers on allegations that Deputy Marcel Van Hattem committed slander and injury against a Federal Police delegate, Fabio Shor, who participated in several investigations involving former president Jair Bolsonaro. Justice Flávio Dino of the Supreme Federal Court submitted his vote to open a criminal action against the deputy during a virtual session. However, the trial was interrupted after Justice Cristiano Zanin requested a highlight, which dictates that the matter be transferred to an in-person session of the Supreme Court's First Panel for further deliberation. The leadership of the Novo party, represented by Eduardo Ribeiro, publicly criticized the vote, characterizing it as a threat to parliamentary immunity and an act of democratic abnormality. The situation has prompted broader discussions regarding the boundaries of parliamentary conduct and the legal protection afforded to elected officials in Brazil.
whyItIsViral: This development is being tracked by multiple national outlets, drawing attention due to the implications for parliamentary immunity and ongoing political tensions.
